authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Not generic Grixis cEDH (blueprint L48); no generic extra turns or Oracle/Breach (L49).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Blockers, fogs and removal stop the engine.

mitigations: Upkeep value even without the combo

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Many upkeep engines cost four to six mana.

value.interaction: Mana Drain, Swan Song, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deadly Rollick, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge.
value.protection: Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Greaves, Boots, Dragonfire Blade.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Obeka's combat-damage trigger is the deck's resource multiplier, and she's in all 5 Spellbook combos in the list.
accepted_role.honest_note: Strongly commander-native: every combo includes Obeka (Time Sieve + Court of Vantress/Thopter Spy Network/Replicating Ring/Smaug; Mechanized Production). She has to connect in combat first, so a 2/5 menace attacker is the bottleneck, and the extra upkeeps arrive after combat. M1 review (obekass-01..05, all verified) confirms the extra-upkeep rules; Roaming Throne + Wizard's Staff gives three triggers, not four (obekass-03).
